describes: Prose vectors for the deontic plane's producer: plain English sentences and the structured statements (statement.schema.json shape) the language lowers each one to. An empty expected list means the sentence states no norm. The first seven are the credit-decision case; the rest cover the published condition and exception cues and the negative-determiner prohibition.
